name: Abelflex
tagline: EXPANSION JOINT AND SPACE FILLER (Zip Rolls)
summary: A flexible, lightweight, closed cell, cross-linked, polyethylene foam expansion joint and space filler. Used in concrete and brickwork, Abelflex is compressible and has excellent recovery properties.
metaDescription: A flexible, lightweight, closed cell, cross-linked, polyethylene foam expansion joint and space filler. In concrete and brickwork Abelflex has excellent recovery properties.
usage: Ideal as a gap filler and bond breaker for floor and wall expansion joints, filling systems for roads, motorways, bridges, brick and block walls, concrete and automotive applications
In joints where polystyrene or bitumen impregnated fillers have been used, Abelflex is ideal as a bondbreaker. Often necessary due to sealant incompatibility with these forms of fillers
Suitable as a back-up filler for most elastomeric joint sealants
Ideal for stopping contaminants such as soil and debris entering the expansion slots and joints
advantages: • Non-absorbent • Excellent recovery after compression • Readily compressible • Seals gaps against dust, debris and water entry • Easy to work with and cut • Resistant to most chemicals • Compatible with most elastomeric joint sealants • Lightweight and easy to handle on-site • Easily moulded to suit other applications
packaging: 10mm x 50mm x 25m 10mm x 75mm x 25m 10mm x 100mm x 25m

rel.t: Expansion Joint and Space Filler (Zip Handy Pack)
rel.s: A flexible, lightweight, closed cell, cross-linked, polyethylene foam expansion joint and space filler. In concrete and brickwork Abelflex has excellent recovery properties.
a: Seals gaps against dust and water entry.
Non-bleeding and resistance to fungi and insect attack (approved to AS2170) making it ideal for use in food contact applications.

rel.s: An exceptionally strong and lightweight closed cell, polyethylene foam rod expansion joint and space filler.
a: Assists with joint design by providing a bond breaker and helping to determine the depth of the joint.
Excellent recovery properties enable Abelflex Rod filler to withstand many years of compression and expansion, ensuring a tight seal from dirt and water entry.
Highly resistant to weathering and most common chemicals.
Meets the requirements of Australian Standard AS2170, “Plastic Materials for Food Contact Use”.
